purpose: Standard machine-readable decision model for evaluating new frameworks, packages, tooling and platform capabilities before roadmap adoption.
adoption_rule: Novelty is not a benefit by itself. Adopt only when compatibility is proven, lifecycle risk is acceptable and expected net ROI is positive for a real SongChart semantic owner.
replacement_rule: Every adopted package or framework capability must name custom code it retires or prevents; permanent dual implementations are prohibited unless explicitly time-bounded with retirement evidence.
reevaluation_triggers: semantic surface is touched by a bounded tranche
major upstream compatibility or security change
existing custom surface becomes a repeated maintenance hotspot
new official Laravel capability can replace third-party or custom infrastructure
authority_rule: Long-lived decisions are recorded in repository machine authorities. Chat discussion may propose decisions but is not the durable record.
